title: CB3D12 self-anchored suspension bridge form-finding vs ANSYS NLGEOM
description: 48 nodes / 65 elements, 20 main-cable segments + 17 hangers; main cable anchored at girder ends, H compresses the girder; longitudinal restraint at midspan. Same geometry/load parameters as CB3D11, only the structural system differs.
reference_source: ANSYS 18.0 (BEAM4 + LINK180 + NLGEOM + INISTATE) batch results frozen in cases/cb3d12_susp_self_nl_ansys_{disp,reac,link}.csv; generated by BridgeStudio/ansys_bridge_susp.py + ansys_bridge_nl.py from the same ModelSpec3D + FEM form-finding result
geometry_note: ANSYS initial geometry = design geometry D = [ERECTED] + [U], NOT [ERECTED]. [CAMBER]/[ERECTED] are camber suggestions only; L0 is back-computed from the equilibrated chord length. Using [ERECTED] directly gives a 0.25 relative displacement error.
tolerance: |got-ref| <= atol + rtol*scale, rtol=2e-3; scale is the per-group max(|FEM|,|ANSYS|), identical to compare_susp()
